title: BoJ Summary of Opinions — December 17-18, 2026 MPM
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed row-by-row out of its two year tables by this session, independently of the fetches that seeded the sibling BoJ entries. Against the header 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2026 December row parses exactly as ['Dec. 17 (Thurs.), 18 (Fri.)', '-', 'Dec. 28 (Mon.)', 'Jan. 27 (Wed.), 2027'] — i.e. the Summary of Opinions for the December 2026 MPM publishes 2026-12-28, with no Outlook Report attached to that meeting and the full Minutes following 2027-01-27. Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the seven BoJ entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Release time is not read off this page and is not asserted here.
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-2026-11-20 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and filed for one specific reason rather than for completeness — it is the only venue where that ledger's central finding is checkable at all. That finding: the BoJ's meeting calendar has two CPI-input regimes. Measuring days from the last national CPI release to MPM day one, the Outlook-Report meetings convene 3, 6 and 6 days after a print (2026-04-27, 2026-07-30, 2026-10-29; the 2027-01-21 Outlook meeting is the outlier at 34 days, the year-end release gap), while every non-Outlook meeting convenes 24-27 days after one (2026-03-18, 2026-06-15, 2026-09-17, 2026-12-17, 2027-03-17). December 2026 is a non-Outlook meeting — this page's own column reads '-' — so the national October print (japan-cpi-2026-11-20, estimate) is the ONLY whole-country CPI observation the board holds when it convenes on 2026-12-17, and it is the first national print the 2026-10-30 Outlook Report never saw. A Summary of Opinions summarises views expressed AT the meeting it names, across both days, which makes this document the one place a reader can see whether that October print did any work in the deliberation, and whether the national November print released 08:30 JST on day two (japan-cpi-2026-12-18, estimate) entered the discussion at all or arrived too late to. Neither question has any other public venue before the full Minutes on 2027-01-27, five weeks later. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and the BoJ channel to this calendar's AI names runs through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledgers. Precedent for filing a central-bank meeting-account release as its own entry: boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29, fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 and ecb-account-2026-10-08, all kind 'macro-print'.
